images.caption: Figure 1:Motion-aware reward model. The pixel stream encodes source and edited videos, while a dynamics stream computes tanh-normalized RGB differences of the edited video. Their features are fused at block 4 of the Qwen3-VL-32B backbone and adapted with LoRA. Training combines pairwise preferences over original edits and motion-suppressed or fabricated-motion negatives with a distillation anchor to the base preference reward.

Figure S1:Motion ladders for three VE-Bench edits. Columns show six uniformly sampled frames. Hold-2 and hold-4 repeat every second or fourth frame, respectively; frozen repeats the first frame. Variants retain the clip length but use subsets of the original frames.
